headline: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
summary: A car rammed into a crowd at a Berlin Pride event. A police manhunt is ongoing for the suspect. The incident occurred on Saturday night in the German capital.

headline: Firefighters battle wildfire as tens of thousands evacuated near Bordeaux
summary: Wildfires rage near Bordeaux, requiring massive evacuations. Over 330,000 people evacuated across France and Spain. Firefighters are battling the blazes intensely.

headline: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
summary: Prime Minister Burnham will challenge Trump if it benefits Britain. He confirmed a productive first conversation with the US president. Burnham emphasized defending national interests above all.

headline: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
summary: PM Andy Burnham ruled out an early general election. He cited a mandate to honor the voted-for manifesto. The announcement came during an exclusive BBC interview.
